title: A solid foundation
intro: Give your website or application a dependable home, with infrastructure choices that fit its needs.
overviewText: We help plan and configure hosting, domains, and deployment workflows. Backups, monitoring, and maintenance are defined around the needs of your project.

deliverables.text: Configure an appropriate environment for your website or application.

deliverables.title: Domains & DNS
deliverables.text: Connect domains and services with clear ownership and configuration.

deliverables.title: Deployment workflows

deliverables.title: Maintenance planning
